q: We show RESPECT to our parents and elders by ____. (P1)
explain: Greeting politely and obeying instructions demonstrate good character and respect.

q: Telling the TRUTH at all times even when difficult is called ____. (P1)
explain: Honesty builds trust and integrity in the home and classroom.

q: In school, pupils should obey classroom ____. (P1)
explain: School rules ensure safety, order, and effective learning.
hint: Guidelines for good behavior in class.

q: The Nigerian national flag has ____ vertical stripes. (P1)
explain: The Nigerian flag features three equal vertical bands: Green, White, and Green.

q: The GREEN color on the Nigerian flag represents ____. (P1)
explain: Green symbolizes Nigeria's rich natural resources and agriculture.

q: The WHITE color on the Nigerian flag represents ____. (P1)
explain: White represents peace, truth, and national cohesion.

q: Civic duty (P1): Paying taxes promptly to the government is a civic ____.
explain: duty / obligation is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P1): Protecting public utilities like streetlights and water pipes is the responsibility of ____.
explain: all citizens is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P1): A citizen should always obey lawful orders from the ____.
explain: police and courts is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P1): Treating people of different ethnic groups and religions with kindness is called ____.
explain: tolerance and unity is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P1): Which of these is a civic responsibility of a student in school?
explain: Keeping the school compound clean is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P1): A child's right to life, healthcare, and education is protected by the ____ Act.
explain: Child Rights is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P1): When singing the National Anthem, citizens should ____.
explain: stand upright and pay attention is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P1): The Independent Corrupt Practices Commission is abbreviated as ____.
explain: ICPC is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P1): Refusing to join secret cults and violence in school demonstrates moral ____.
explain: courage and discipline is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P1): The National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) was established in 1973 to promote national ____.
explain: unity and integration is the essential civic principle.
